text: The Multipurpose Automation Box (MAB) is a monitoring and control solution for power grids. It provides a preconfigured package for monitoring and remote control of assets, increasing supply safety and helping operators gain transparency through IoT applications. This fully assembled, pre-wired box offers a versatile solution with minimized space requirements and a minimum total cost of ownership.
heading: Why Multipurpose Automation Box?

text: The Multipurpose Automation Box assembles proven Siemens components into a customizable, preconfigured solution for monitoring, remote control and connection points for renewable energies, eliminating multi-vendor complexity.
heading: Flexible, preconfigured automation platform

text: Designed with IT security, scalability and rugged environmental tolerance, the box supports reliable field deployment and enables secure communication for grid assets across diverse operating conditions.
heading: Scalable, secure grid-edge operation

text: The box can host grid applications and self-healing capabilities, helping operators detect issues, restore service and gain transparency through IoT-based insights — all in a compact, space-efficient design.
heading: Built-in applications and self-healing functions
